subject: Portfolio reconciliation & attrition alerts: action required
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Portfolio reconciliation & attrition alerts: action required

Team —

Quick nudge on the Q2 renewal recon we kicked off last week. Finance ran a cursory pass and surfaced a handful of accounts where committed ARR and stage tags don't align with our records; a few show churn signals in usage and CS notes. Please do the following by EOD Thursday (2027-03-25):

1) Update stage + commit for any renewal in your book in the Q2_recon_template.xlsx (attached). Use committed ARR only when you have a signed PO or documented verbal commit from a named exec.
2) Flag churn signals in the churn-signal-checklist.md (attached) — we care about: declining token usage >30% MoM, contract disputes logged in CS, exec turnover, and unpaid invoices older than 30 days.
3) If you mark an account as "At Risk / Churn" include rationale and one suggested mitigation (credit, exec outreach, product swap).

I will consolidate feeds into Finance on Friday morning for forecast adjustments. If an account needs an immediate hold or credit approval beyond the standard playbook, call it out explicitly in your row and cc me.

Side notes:
- Acme Energy (Laura) looks like it needs a deeper dive — billing flagged an open invoice from Jan and CS noted a drop in usage.
- Naomi: please verify any finance holds in the ledger before finalizing committed ARR.

Thanks — short focused updates please.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Billing Ops <billing@acme-energy.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:15:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio reconciliation & attrition alerts: action required

Rishi — thanks for the clear ask. Quick status from my side:

- I updated Q2_recon_template.xlsx for my book (rows highlighted). Committed ARR updated for three deals: Acme Energy, NorthPoint Utilities, and Meridian Labs.
- Acme Energy: CS confirmed a 42% drop in monthly token consumption since Jan. Billing (cc) says an invoice from 2027-01-18 remains unpaid; legal has a note but no formal dispute. I’ve attached the Acme_MAP_redline.pdf that shows the proposed concession they asked for last week.
- Marked Acme as "At Risk" in the template with notes: unpaid invoice, exec PO delayed, usage decline. Suggested mitigation: 3-month credit + executive call from Sean.

Attachment: Acme_MAP_redline.pdf (redline of MAP)

Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:07:38 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio reconciliation & attrition alerts: action required

Looping procurement context in — I forwarded the template to procure@globaltech.com for the Meridian Labs PO confirmation you asked about, Laura. Procurement replied that the PO was approved but the finance team is backlogged; expected clearance by 2027-03-29.

On Acme: I ran a quick ledger check and flagged a mismatch between the invoice on file and the payment they reported. Naomi — can you validate whether Finance put a hold? If there is a ledger hold we should not count the invoice as committed ARR.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Laura / Rishi —

Thanks for the heads up and for flagging the payment timing. Our finance team had an internal delay approving the Jan invoice due to a vendor consolidation project; that has been cleared as of yesterday and payment should post by 2027-03-29. I apologize for the noise and the drop in consumption — we did pause one integration during a cost review.

We anticipate renewing with Redwood, but we are asking whether Redwood can accommodate a short-term usage credit to smooth the transition while we re-enable integrations and complete the PO. If you can share the credit terms (amount/duration) and confirm the renewal timeline, I will expedite our exec signature.

Jane Porter
CFO, Acme Energy
